row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote-only; priced by admin users and inventory)
row.evidence: OneTrust's developer portal documents SCIM 2.0 Users and Groups APIs 'so that you can automatically provision and deprovision users within the OneTrust application using your organization’s identity provider', while every OneTrust package on the pricing page is quote-only ('Get Pricing').
row.notes: Quote-only: every package (AI Governance, Consent & Preferences, Privacy Automation, Tech Risk & Compliance, Third-Party Management) is 'Get Pricing', priced by admin users plus inventory, visitors or profiles. SCIM is documented publicly on developer.onetrust.com with two generations: a Legacy SCIM Integration (/api/scim/v2, SCIM groups = role-organization combinations) and an Enhanced SCIM Integration (/api/scim/v3, user groups that carry roles, plus ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas and ResourceTypes). Auth is OAuth 2.0 client credentials created in Global Settings with the SCIM scope. Deprovisioning is deactivation (active=false via PATCH/PUT); DELETE /Users is documented as 'not available at this time'. The Okta OIN app is SAML plus Workflows connector (no SCIM tick) and the Entra gallery app is SSO with JIT, so IdPs connect through the generic endpoint. A separate Access Management API (v2 users, user groups, roles, organizations, audit records) also exists. Which plans or modules include SCIM is not stated publicly; the help-centre SCIM articles (my.onetrust.com) could not be loaded.

plans.name: All packages (AI Governance, Consent & Preferences, Privacy Automation, Tech Risk & Compliance, Third-Party Management)
plans.price_text: Get Pricing (custom quote; priced by admin users and inventory, visitors or profiles)
plans.notes: No public tier table; the Entra tutorial requires a 'single sign-on enabled subscription'.

scim.base_url: https://{hostname}/api/scim/v3 (Enhanced; legacy /api/scim/v2), hostname e.g. app.onetrust.com, app-eu.onetrust.com, trial.onetrust.com

auth.token_source: Global Settings > OAuth 2.0 client credentials (client_id/client_secret) with the SCIM scope; token from POST /api/access/v1/oauth/token (client_credentials)
auth.notes: Token lifetime is not stated in prose; the example token response shows expires_in 31535999 seconds.

deprovision.data_retained: Users are set inactive (active=false) and remain listed as Inactive users; DELETE /Users is not available.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le.

custom.how: Group resources carry a urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:onetrust:Group extension (category, description); no custom user schema is documented.

attributes.notes: From the v3 Create User / Create User Group OpenAPI definitions. Responses always return roles: [] and organization: null in the Enhanced integration.

roles.how: Legacy: membership in SCIM groups, each a role-organization combination. Enhanced: membership in user groups that carry roles. Users without roles/organization get the defaults set on the User Provisioning screen in Global Settings.

rate_limits.text: User Provisioning API quota 2k calls/minute, 20k calls/hour on /api/scim/*; account default 200,000/hour and 1,000/minute per API; HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

limitations.text: DELETE /Users is documented as not available; deprovisioning is deactivation only.
GET /Users does not return invited users.
v3 GET /Users returns at most 25 users per page.

scim.notes: The SCIM base path is versioned v2 (Legacy SCIM Integration) and v3 (Enhanced SCIM Integration); both follow the SCIM 2.0 core schema. Hostnames per region are listed in the OpenAPI server variable.

endpoints.purpose: Add multiple users to user group
Remove multiple users from user group
Audit records for a user's profile changes

audit_log_api.notes: Login history and user-profile change audit records only.

rate_limits.text: Account default 200,000 requests/hour and 1,000/minute per API; HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

user_api.notes: Access Management API (OpenAPI 'Platform - Access Management'): users, user groups, roles (access levels), organizations and audit records. Endpoints are from the published OpenAPI definition. Plan availability is not stated (quote-only).

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML and Workflows Connectors as checked; SCIM and the provisioning capabilities are unchecked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Gallery app 'OneTrust Privacy Management Software': SP/IdP-initiated SSO with JIT user provisioning; no Entra provisioning tutorial exists (onetrust-provisioning-tutorial 404).
